summary: Telephone and Data Systems (TDS) filed an 8-K on September 1, 2026, announcing it withdrew its proposal to acquire the ~18% of Array Digital Infrastructure common shares it did not already own. The offer terms, per the proposal, were 0.86 TDS common share per Array share. TDS cited failure to agree on consideration and value after extensive review with Array's Special Committee. TDS retains its approximate 82% stake and expects to recommence its share repurchase program. The deal termination removes overhang on Array shares; watch for potential TDS buyback execution and any future strategic moves.
